verses.text: Ha t'a yoxil ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal t'a Persia, ix alchajxi slolonel Dios t'ayin Daniel in tik, Beltsasar pax in b'i. Icha wayich ix aj yalji t'ayin. Ha jun tas ix wab' chi', te yel, syal yuj jun niwan owal, palta ix nachajel wuuj tas syalelk'ochi.
Ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi', oxe' semana ix in och t'a kusk'olal.
Malaj wael wach' ix in wa''a, maj in nib'ej jab'ok chib'ej, maj wuk' pax wino, malaj wal jab'ok perfume ix wak'och t'ayin, masanto ix ek' oxe' semana chi'.
Ayik 24 yoch b'ab'el uj t'a yik ab'il chi', ayinek' t'a sti' ha' niwan Tigris.
Ix in b'at k'elan, ix wilan jun winh winak ayoch spichul nab'a lino yet' jun stzek'ul nab'a oro te wach'.

Toxonhej skopopi sniwanil icha k'een topacio, toxonhej kopopi yilji sat icha lheb'lon. Ha yol sat, sk'e nhilnhon yok icha te' k'ak'. Ha sk'ab' yet' yok, kopopi yilji icha k'een bronce wach' yaj snhikchaji, haxo sjaj, ichawal yoch sjaj junok niwan nhilanh anima.
Ha innhej ix yal wilan jun chi', haxo masanil heb' anima ayek' wet'ok, maj yil-laj heb', yujto ix jawi xiwelal t'a heb', ix b'at heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'a.
Ha inxonhej ayinek' in ch'okoj ayik ix wilan jun chi', ix tup in chik'il, manhxa wip ix wab'i.
Ayik ix wab'an slolonk'e jun chi', ix te pax wip, ix satel in k'ool, ix in em nhojnaj t'a sat lu'um.
Haxo ix aji, ix och yub'yub' jun k'ab' t'ayin, ix in sketzank'e waan, masanto ix yal in k'e kuman yet' sjolom in penek yet' in k'ab'.

Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Daniel, ach xajanab'il yuj Dios, schamwal ab'an tas ol wala'. K'eanh waan, yujto in chekjikot t'ayach, xchi. Ha wal yik ix lajwi yalan juntzanh lolonel chi', toxonhej tzin lukloni, ix in k'e linhan.

Ichato chi' ix yalan t'ayin: Daniel, manh ach xiwok. Yiktax ix a chaanel yich och ejmelal, yik tza k'anan a jelanil, yik snachajel tas ajaltak uuj, ha Dios ix ab'an a lesal. Yuj chi' in chekjikot t'ayach.

Ha jun ángel yajal yaj t'a yol yik Persia, ha' ix in yamanoch waan t'a 21 k'ual. Haxo pax Miguel, haton jun sat ángel yaji, ha' ix jawi yik skolwaj wet'ok, ix kan yak' owal yet' jun yajalil Persia chi'.
Yuj chi' a tiknaik, tzul wak' nachajel uuj tas ol ek' t'a yib'anh a chonhab' tik t'a slajwub' tiempoal. Ha jun ol ch'oxchaj ila', a yuj tas ol ujok t'a slajwub' tiempoal syala', xchi.
Ayik wan yalan juntzanh lolonel chi' t'ayin, majxo yal-laj in loloni, toxonhej ix in em k'elan t'a sat lu'um.

Haxo ix aji, ay jun lajan yilji icha anima, elanhchamel ix syam in ti'. Haxo ix walan t'a jun linhanoch t'a wichanh chi': Mamin, a yuj jun tas ix wil tik, ix och wal pitz'an t'a in k'ool, manhxalaj wip swab'i.
Mamin, ¿tas wal ol aj in lolon het'ok a in a chekab' in tik, yujto manhxalaj wip, maxtzak yal-laj wik'an wik' swab'i? xin chi.
Haxo jun lajan yilji icha anima chi', ix ochxi yamyam t'ayin, ix wik'anxi wip.

Ix yalan t'ayin icha tik: Manh ach xiwok, manh ak' pensar. Te xajan ach yuj Dios. Anhej to tza tek'b'ej a b'a, xchi. Yakb'an wanto slolon chi' t'ayin, ix wik'an wal wip ix wab'i, ix walani: Mamin, lolonanh t'ayin, yujto ix ochxi wip junelxo uuj, xin chi t'ay.

Ix yalan t'ayin: ¿Ojtak hama tas yuj tzin jawi t'ayach? Ol wal t'ayach tas tz'ib'ab'ilem t'a yol ch'anh libro to yel. Ha tiknaik ol wak'pax owal yet' jun ángel yajal yaj t'a Persia. Ayik ol lajwok wak'an owal chi' yet'ok, ol ja jun ángel yajal yaj t'a Grecia. Ha t'a jun owal chi', anhej wal Miguel skolwaj wet'ok, haton jun ángel yajal yaj t'a a chonhab' Israel.
